projects.title: SNMP Network Monitor using Node
projects.description:
Build Node Express.js based SNMP network monitoring application. Evaluated  a few different PaaS providers and deployed to Heroku. Application actively polled SNMP network targets and graphed (Google’s graphing library) results over time. User could also browse supported MIBs and poll individually or setup recurring polls.  
Code: https://github.com/joshlipps/mibbrowser-node
